about: Mask on / mask off for a first-person camera, taken out of the Don Giovanni greybox. demo.html and UDGMaskFXComponent use exactly these numbers.
space: UE camera space: X forward, Y right, Z up. Centimetres. Rotations are FRotator (Pitch, Yaw, Roll) in degrees. The hand pivot is the centre of the palm; each mask pivot is the centre of its bounding box.

how_to_pose.hand: location = lerp(poses_cm[from], poses_cm[to], k); rotation = FRotator(lerp(pitch), 0, lerp(roll))
how_to_pose.mask: location = hand location + mask_offset_cm (the offset is not turned with the hand); hidden when mask_shown is false
how_to_pose.mask_rotation: three single turns applied one after another about the camera axes: first roll = mask_tilt * hand roll, then yaw = -180 * (1 - turn), then pitch = mask_tilt * hand pitch. In UE: FQuat(FRotator(pitch, 0, 0)) * FQuat(FRotator(0, yaw, 0)) * FQuat(FRotator(0, 0, roll)). A single FRotator(pitch, yaw, roll) is NOT the same: while the mask shows its face it would lean the wrong way (up to 48 degrees off).
how_to_pose.turn: put_rise: clamp((k - turn_from) / (1 - turn_from), 0, 1); every other phase: 1. turn 0 shows the face of the mask to the player, 1 its inside.

sequences.input: Ignored while any phase runs. Asking for the mask already on the face does nothing.

events.wear_requested: the wear is accepted (the greybox plays the mask motif here)
events.scene_cue: scene_cue_seconds after put_rise starts (the greybox starts moving the scenery here)
events.mask_on: end of put_press: the mask hides, the blink starts, the vignette fades in
events.take_started: take_reach starts (the greybox puts the scenery back here)
events.mask_off: end of take_reach: the mask shows, the vignette fades out

blink.formula: peak = max_alpha * css_ease(min(t, release_seconds) / ramp_seconds); t <= release_seconds: alpha = peak; after: alpha = peak * (1 - css_ease((t - release_seconds) / fade_seconds))

vignette.image: full-screen RGBA texture stretched to the screen, one per mask (T_DG_Vignette_*)
vignette.formula: on change: from = current alpha, duration = fade_seconds * |target - from|, alpha = lerp(from, target, css_ease(t / duration))

sound.note: note_gain is before the greybox master gain 0.6; the WAV files are normalised to a -6 dBFS peak
